coverage.target: In-process decision module: catalogue lookup plus comparisons, no I/O (performance-design.md)
StatusReaderLocal: one indexed read, 2 s acquire and statement timeouts, no retry
No remote status read exists: the C4 route terminates in the Identity service, so every path uses StatusReaderLocal (200 ms acquire, 100 ms statement, no retry)
AuthorizeRoute: one hop plus one status read; allow budget
AuthorizeRoute denial path includes the synchronous AuditSink write before returning
500 ms overall C4 call deadline, then 503
AuditSinkClient: one bounded write per denial, 500 ms ceiling
RoleChangeRoute: intent audit write, provider write, outcome audit write
authorisation_decision_duration_seconds histogram labelled by path (observability-design.md)
authorisation_decisions_total counter labelled by operation_class, outcome, and reason
authorisation_status_lookup_errors_total counter with cause label; alert above 1% over 5 minutes
authorisation_audit_write_failures_total counter; page alert on any non-zero over 5 minutes
authorisation_role_changes_total counter with outcome label; alert above 5% failures over 30 minutes
authorisation_cache_age_seconds and authorisation_cache_entries gauges; cache-age alert above 30 seconds
Token validated against JWKS by the caller's middleware and again at the C4 boundary
AuthorizeRoute: per-service token plus per-operation allowlist plus the user's validated JWT
RoleChangeRoute requires the admin's forwarded JWT beside the service token
Caller identity builder reads only app_metadata.role; anything else is owner
OperationCatalogue: unknown name is undeclared and denied
Evaluation order: status, support, class, ownership; collections return the owner filter
Refusal and nonexistent id both answer 404 with the same problem body
Support denied at every owner-scoped, collection, and administrative class
No token, subject plaintext, credential, or secret in logs, audit, or responses
No new role or schema access; the decision borrows the service's pool and reads one row
SupabaseRoleWriter: the only write outside the audit trail, through the provider admin API
AuditSink gates every denial; role change writes requested then changed in the C9 enum
Audit failure becomes audit_unavailable and a 503; role change aborts before the provider write
Audit entry fields are fixed; a value that would carry a secret is refused or redacted
Constant cost per decision: no per-user table, no scan
Stateless decision; scaling is replica count only
70% sustained CPU per replica is the scale trigger (scalability-design.md)
Capacity figure recorded as an assumption to confirm at Build and Test
Status read every request; the outage-only cache bounds staleness at 30 s
Dependencies bounded by timeout; designed failures answer 503
Outage-only StatusCache: 30 s TTL, 10 000 entries, LRU
/readyz reports the status source; a lookup alert rather than a restart loop
Nothing persisted; recovery is the platform's own backup of Auth and the audit store
